questions.q: What does Paul boast of the Thessalonians for?
questions.evidence: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure

questions.q: Who must be revealed before the day of Christ, Paul says?
questions.evidence: For it will not be, unless the departure comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction

questions.q: Paul says anyone unwilling to work should go without what?
questions.evidence: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone will not work, don’t let him eat
